zh-CN.title: 成玄英
zh-CN.shortSummary: 成玄英提供了观察唐初《道德经》《庄子》解释活动与道教知识网络的入口。
curatorialDescription: 本条目把注疏活动放在文本版本、宫观与帝国知识制度之间，而不把后世归纳直接当作生平事实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 生卒年、具体任职和注本传承仍需以版本目录及人物资料逐项核定。

en.title: Cheng Xuanying
en.shortSummary: Cheng Xuanying offers an entry into early Tang interpretation of the Daodejing and Zhuangzi and its Daoist knowledge networks.
curatorialDescription: The record places commentary among text versions, Daoist institutions and imperial knowledge systems without treating later summaries as direct biography.
en.researchNote: Life dates, offices and commentary transmission still require item-level verification against catalogues and biographical records.

zh-CN.title: 颜师古
zh-CN.shortSummary: 颜师古连接唐初经典校订、注释实践与国家知识工程。
curatorialDescription: 他的条目用于展示文本整理并非孤立书斋活动，而与官学、版本和政治制度相关。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充具体校勘项目、版本沿革与制度任职的卷页级来源。

en.title: Yan Shigu
en.shortSummary: Yan Shigu connects early Tang textual editing and commentary with state knowledge projects.
curatorialDescription: His record shows that textual scholarship was not isolated study but was connected to official learning, editions and institutions.
en.researchNote: Specific editorial projects, edition histories and offices still require volume- and page-level sources.

zh-CN.title: 吉藏
zh-CN.shortSummary: 吉藏的讲学与注疏活动为隋唐之际佛教思想、文本解释和城市网络提供案例。
curatorialDescription: 条目强调人物、著述与机构环境的连接，并保留宗派标签形成史中的复杂性。
zh-CN.researchNote: 具体行迹、著作版本和宗派归属表述需继续核对佛教传记与目录资料。

en.title: Jizang
en.shortSummary: Jizang's teaching and commentary provide a case for Buddhist thought, textual interpretation and urban networks across the Sui–Tang transition.
curatorialDescription: The record links figure, writings and institutions while preserving the complexity of later school labels.
en.researchNote: Itinerary, textual editions and school attribution still require verification in Buddhist biographies and catalogues.
